title: Bashigram Lake
subtitle: Alpine glacial lake above Bashigram village, east of Madyan
road: Puran Chail Road and Gam Road to Bashigram, then an unnamed track
osm_use: the road from the Madyan junction up to Bashigram village and the unclassified track to its end at Mughlmar, the lake outline (Bashigram Lake way); no footpath to the lake is mapped
